reason: Session-tier self-check rewired onto ai-shared-lib/go/roster (SC-MODELROSTER): the hardcoded modelRank map is deleted, ordering comes from roster.Compare, an unrecognized model resolves to a distinct roster-stale verdict instead of ranking below every known model (the FB8 defect), and the band may be supplied by name via a roster-resolved --band flag. This is the declared argv change SC-MODELROSTER's design names as landing in M0, before SC-DAT-FROZEN's golden fixture is captured -- the fixture records the post-M0 surface, not this one.

deltas.detail: New --band NAME flag selects a named roster-resolved band (currently: plan, build) in place of the four literal --floor-*/--ceiling-* flags.

deltas.field: flags[].required for floor-model, floor-effort, ceiling-model, ceiling-effort
deltas.detail: Each changes from unconditionally required:true to required unless --band is set; supplying --band satisfies the band requirement without them.

["band", "floor-model"], ["band", "floor-effort"], ["band", "ceiling-model"], ["band", "ceiling-effort"] -- supplying --band together with any literal band flag is a usage error (exit 2): "self-check: --band and --floor-*/--ceiling-* are mutually exclusive".
New exit-2 case: an unrecognized --band name ("self-check: unrecognized --band %q"). Existing exit-2 cases (missing literal flags, undeterminable model, identity-guard IO errors) are unchanged.

New boolean verdict field (JSON key roster_stale, omitempty): true when the observed model or a band endpoint is absent from the roster (roster.Compare / roster.Lookup returned a StaleError). Always false, and omitted from output, when abort or a normal pass/warn verdict is returned.

New exit code 3: roster_stale:true. Previously an unrecognized model had no roster to consult, ranked below every entry in the hardcoded modelRank table, and hard-aborted (exit 1) as if it were simply too weak (the FB8 defect). It now resolves to this distinct roster-stale verdict instead; abort stays false on this path.

Previously: "<model>/<effort> is below the floor <floor-model>/<floor-effort>" (the model had silently ranked at -1). Now: the underlying roster.StaleError message, e.g. "roster-stale: \"<model>\" is not in the model roster (query: <model>) -- refresh model-roster.json (see schemas/model-roster/README.md, \"Refreshing it\") to resolve this", naming the refresh action. Every KNOWN model's reason text, for every band form, is byte-identical to the pre-M0 baseline.

The self-check usage line documents the new {--floor-*/--ceiling-* | --band NAME} alternative, the roster_stale stdout field and the new exit code 3. This is the ONLY line of usage() text that changed; testdata/pre-m0-baseline/help.txt's byte-for-byte comparison test (TestPreM0Baseline_HelpOutputMatchesGoldenByteForByte) now fails against the frozen pre-M0 golden by design -- that failure IS this declared delta, reconciled by M0.P6.T1's post-M0 differential, not a regression to silence.

unchanged: Every KNOWN model's abort/warn/pass verdict and reason text is behaviorally identical between the literal-flags form and any equivalent --band form, and identical to the pre-M0 baseline for every pre-M0 fixture that names only known models.
The four literal --floor-model/--floor-effort/--ceiling-model/--ceiling-effort flags still parse and, supplied alone (no --band), behave exactly as before.
Exit codes 0 and 1, and every exit-2 case that existed before this task, are unchanged.
The identity guard (--session-id/--scratchpad-path) and its session_id_checked/session_id_match fields are untouched.
